title: Joe Schoen: My role hasn't changed, I'm still leading football operations

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Joe Schoen: My role hasn't changed, I'm still leading football operations
sources.description: When the Giants hired John Harbaugh as their head coach earlier this year, they changed one of the traditional modes of operation in the franchise by having Harbaugh report directly to ownership rather than to the General Manager.
